scope: Released PC Windows product lines, official feature/LTSC/LTSB releases and documented service packs and Windows 8.1 Update; Ubuntu Desktop/Server releases and archived image revisions. No monthly KB updates, preview-only product versions, mobile/CE platforms or package revisions. Architecture options can include documented Insider builds of a released version; architecture_channels distinguishes the channel. Navigation groups Windows by Desktop, Server, PE and IoT; the Embedded category and its nineteen records and routes are deleted. Other legacy routes are retained. PE entries include the documented legacy selection and fifteen separately identified Windows 10/11 ADK base builds; this is not an exhaustive development-build inventory. Architecture choices belong to each canonical version; old architecture-qualified URLs are compatibility aliases and not separate version-directory entries. Product editions are not selectable or independently listed; former edition URLs resolve to the matching build. ARM32 architecture options and routes are excluded.
